title: Patch-Panel Status Strip
summary: Inspect endpoint freshness by branch and trace each status to its last check-in.
interactionSpecs: Group ports by branch in two rows.
Inspect online, stale and never-seen endpoints by keyboard or pointer.
codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Component;

class PatchPanelStrip extends Component
{
    private const PORTS = [
        ['name' => 'NH-WS-014', 'branch' => 'North Hub', 'seen' => '2026-03-10T09:58:00Z'],
        ['name' => 'NH-SRV-FILE', 'branch' => 'North Hub', 'seen' => '2026-03-10T09:59:00Z'],
        ['name' => 'HO-LT-007', 'branch' => 'Harbor Office', 'seen' => '2026-03-10T08:12:00Z'],
        ['name' => 'HO-WS-021', 'branch' => 'Harbor Office', 'seen' => '2026-03-10T09:57:00Z'],
        ['name' => 'CC-WS-003', 'branch' => 'Central Campus', 'seen' => null],
        ['name' => 'CC-SRV-APP', 'branch' => 'Central Campus', 'seen' => '2026-03-10T09:59:30Z'],
    ];
    public string $selected = 'NH-WS-014';

    public function inspect(string $name): void
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($name, array_column(self::PORTS, 'name'), true), 422);
        $this->selected = $name;
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        $ports = collect(self::PORTS)->map(function (array $port): array {
            $port['state'] = match (true) {
                $port['seen'] === null => 'Never seen',
                strtotime('2026-03-10T10:00:00Z') - strtotime($port['seen']) > 15 * 60 => 'Stale',
                default => 'Online',
            };
            return $port;
        });
        return view('livewire.patch-panel-strip', [
            'groups' => $ports->groupBy('branch'),
            'current' => $ports->firstWhere('name', $this->selected) ?? $ports->first(),
        ]);
    }
}
